intended_object: The K-subspace P_α of the degree-α homogeneous component of the graded ring attached to the degree valuation on K((ℝ^{≤0})). It consists of the classes that are zero or have a principal representative of degree exactly α (LM24, Definition 5.2.1, Proposition 5.2.4 and Corollary 5.2.5). The source is the docstring together with the docstring of `IsPrincipalDegreeClass`.
explanation:
The carrier is the set {x | IsPrincipalDegreeClass α x}. A class x satisfies this predicate when x = 0, or when x is the degree-α class of some principal series p whose degree is exactly α. This is the definition of a principal homogeneous class in LM24, Definition 5.2.1, as cited in the docstring.

The proof obligations check that this set is a K-subspace. That is the content of LM24, Proposition 5.2.4 and Corollary 5.2.5:
- **Sums:** if the sum of two classes is nonzero, then p + q has degree exactly α, and it is principal by `add_of_degree_eq`.
- **Scalars:** a nonzero constant times a principal series is again principal and has the same degree.

Because the closure properties are proved inside the definition, building the subspace imposes no extra conditions.

The object is specific to this setting: it is defined from the degree valuation on nonpositive Hahn series over a field K, and the notion of a principal series depends on that ring. Mathlib has no general version of it, so the definition is not too narrow.
